description: This PHP source file defines the class AntlrParser, which extends BaseRecognizer. It implements a parser for TokenStreams, providing methods for resetting the parser, obtaining the current input symbol, handling missing symbols, setting and getting the token stream, retrieving source name, and tracing parser rule entries and exits.

classes.name: AntlrParser
classes.description: A parser class for TokenStreams, supporting parsing operations and symbol handling, extending BaseRecognizer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with input TokenStream and optional state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state and rewinds the input stream if it exists.

methods.name: getCurrentInputSymbol
methods.description: Returns the current input symbol from the TokenStream.

methods.name: getMissingSymbol
methods.description: Creates and returns a token representing a missing symbol, handling end-of-file cases.

methods.name: setTokenStream
methods.description: Sets the input TokenStream and resets the parser state.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the source name of the input stream.

methods.name: traceIn
methods.description: Logs entry into a parser rule for tracing.

methods.name: traceOut
methods.description: Logs exit from a parser rule for tracing.
